reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.lead: GrowSafe has no accounts and no server, so it can't send notifications. Instead it makes a calendar file. When you open it, your own calendar app (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook) adds the events and does the reminding.
reminders.times: Times are your local time, wherever you are. Nothing is sent anywhere.
reminders.weekly.heading: Weekly check-in
reminders.weekly.hint: Ten minutes: do one fix from Today.
reminders.monthly.heading: Monthly room re-check
reminders.monthly.hint: Pick rooms to look at again. They are spread over the first four weeks of each month.
reminders.monthly.none: Add a home with rooms first, then you can pick rooms here.
reminders.plan.heading: Plan updates
reminders.plan.toggle: When a child reaches a new age
reminders.plan.hint: A one-day event for each child's next few age milestones, on the 15th of the month (only the birth month is stored).
reminders.nothing: Choose at least one reminder above.
reminders.ready: Calendar file ready. Open it and your calendar app will add the events.
reminders.link.sub: Add repeating events to your calendar
reminders.ics.weekly.title: Weekly: 10-minute GrowSafe check-in
reminders.ics.weekly.desc: Open GrowSafe and do one fix from Today. Ten minutes is enough.
reminders.ics.monthly.title: Monthly: re-check the {room}
reminders.ics.monthly.desc: Look at this room again with fresh eyes, then open GrowSafe to tick off anything you fix.
reminders.ics.plan.title: Update your plan: {name} turns {age}
reminders.ics.plan.desc: {name} reaches a new age. Open GrowSafe to see if new fixes have appeared. The date is the 15th of the birth month, because only the month is stored.
